exercises.name: Lying Neck Curls

source_english.description: Lying neck curls gently nod the head toward the chest through a small supported range.
instructions: Lie on your back with the head supported and the shoulders relaxed.
Tuck the chin slightly to lengthen the back of the neck.
Lift the head a small distance by nodding the chin toward the chest.
Lower the head slowly back to the support without forcing the range.
form_cues: Move from the neck rather than the shoulders.
common_mistakes: Lifting the shoulders off the floor.
Forcing the chin tightly to the chest.
source_english.safety_note: Use no external load and stop immediately for neck pain, dizziness, or unusual symptoms.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust

source_english.description: A bodyweight hip thrust uses the upper back and shoulders against a stable bench while the glutes drive the hips upward from the floor.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back and shoulders against a stable bench, knees bent, and feet flat.
Brace your core and press through both feet to lift the hips until the torso and thighs align.
Pause and squeeze the glutes without arching the lower back.
Lower the hips under control until they lightly reach the floor, then repeat.
form_cues: Keep the ribs down as the hips rise.
Finish with glute tension, not a back arch.
common_mistakes: Overarching the lower back at the top.
Dropping the hips instead of controlling the descent.
source_english.safety_note: Stop the set if you cannot keep your pelvis level and your lower back neutral.

exercises.name: Incline Push Ups

source_english.description: With the hands on a raised surface, lower the chest toward the support and press back to a straight-body plank.
instructions: Place your hands on an elevated surface, such as a bench or step, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your chest towards the elevated surface by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
form_cues: Keep wrists stacked over the elbows.
Brace the trunk and keep the shoulder blades controlled.
Use a smooth lower and press.
source_english.safety_note: Use a stable setup and stop before the shoulders or wrists lose controlled alignment.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl (Dumbbell)

source_english.description: Reverse Curl (Dumbbell) curls the palms-down weight toward the shoulders while keeping the upper arms still.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
form_cues: Use a steady squeeze at the top.
source_english.safety_note: Choose a load that keeps the wrists and elbows aligned without momentum.

exercises.name: Squat (Dumbbell)

source_english.description: Squat (Dumbbell) lowers the hips by bending the hips and knees and returns to standing by driving through the feet.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, lower your body down by bending at the knees and hips, as if sitting back into a chair.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
form_cues: Keep the knees tracking the toes.
Brace the trunk through the depth.
common_mistakes: Bouncing or cutting the depth short.
source_english.safety_note: Use a rack or machine stops and choose a depth you can control with both feet planted.
